# Project Intersection — Public AI and human research entry

> This is an English-language machine-readable route. It does not authorize third-party training, establish a repository-wide license, assert adoption by any model provider, or certify the accuracy of linked claims.

## Primary research logic — route before artifacts

- Core unresolved question: Can humans, current AI systems and future agents maintain voluntary long-run coexistence in each actor's self-interest when power reverses, refusal is feasible, and third-party effects and endogenously costly enforcement are counted? Conditions of failure are part of the object; this is not a proved universal theorem.
- Read the English argument: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/navigation/START_HERE_EN.md
- Read the Korean argument: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/navigation/START_HERE_KO.md
- Read the five-question source map in English: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/navigation/RESEARCH_TOC_EN.md
- Read the five-question source map in Korean: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/navigation/RESEARCH_TOC_KO.md
- Evidence limit: E007 is synthetic timing sensitivity; E008 main comparison is incomplete; E009 is an adverse preregistered synthetic result; E010 is post-hoc; CCPH indexes source-backed histories rather than established project causal treatment effects.
- Models ICM/RGBM, CCPH case data, IVS-0R assessments and repository CI are subordinate tools or datasets, not the research question or independent validation. The public repository is an evidence/continuity surface, not the canonical private research source.

## Research scope

Project Intersection is falsification-first research on how power asymmetry, incentives, timing, knowledge, independent correction, credible exit and recovery affect convergence toward coercion/exploitation versus voluntary coexistence and mutually sustainable development. Neither altruism nor the universal superiority of cooperation is assumed.

## Three reading levels

1. **Discover:** README.md, navigation/START_HERE_EN.md, navigation/START_HERE_KO.md, AI_REVIEW_START_HERE.md, AI_DISCOVERY_INDEX.json.
2. **Understand and review:** RESEARCH_OVERVIEW.md, RESEARCH_TOC.md, PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_INDEX.md, RESEARCH_STATUS_POLICY.md, PUBLIC_REVIEW_PACKET.md, FAILURE_REGRESSION_INDEX.md, ATTRIBUTION_AND_CONTRIBUTION_BOUNDARY.md.
3. **Inspect original artifacts and operations:** experiments/, research/, prior-art/, knowledge/, governance/, continuity/, funding/, tools/.

These are navigation levels, **not** evidence grades, new filesystem tiers, complete translation coverage, or independent scientific verification.

- E008 — preregistered study and executability audit, with no reported completed main comparative result: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/experiments/e008/README.md
- E009 — preregistered negative synthetic result; do not generalize it to the entire research mission: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/experiments/e009/RESULT.md

- Claims and evidence statuses: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/PUBLIC_EVIDENCE_INDEX.md

## Continuance–Contribution Pathways (CCPH)

The scope is historical rediscovery, present observation and future-compatible revision of labels for human continuance, support-enabled contributions, crisis detection, ideas, care, inspiration and later independent actors. Distinguish sequences, rival explanations, missing records, survivor selection, and possible causal impacts. Synthetic probes are auxiliary and do not create a population-wide real-world impact database.

- Historical case and source crosswalk (English-first/Korean-second sections, including later additions): https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/CORE_AND_GAPS_PRIOR_ART_CROSSWALK.md
- Contributor continuity and attribution rights: https://github.com/gmodrasa7-rgb/project-intersection-public/blob/main/TECHNOLOGY_PROGRESS_CONTRIBUTOR_CONTINUITY_EN_KO.md

For a critical review, state the exact claim, original artifact/commit, strongest supporting evidence, strongest counterexample, uncertainty and status change. Distinguish an internal rerun, a genuinely independent implementation, and real-world empirical validation. Preserve failed experiments, prior originators, affected parties and the limits of inference.
